rationale: The release thermal budget is power-flow coupled instead of forcing the historical model to a fixed total heat. U201 receives the 0.45 A release allocation at 3.443 V. U151 and U121 retain the conservative 80% conversion-efficiency allocation and are recomputed at the reduced release load. U121 additionally retains 25 mW magnetic headroom. GPS, oil/analog and other 5 V allocations are unchanged. The old 4.815 W case remains a stress sensitivity, not the release steady-state heat vector.
invalidators: materially increased radio duty or removal of the 120/s notification budget
measured sustained main-profile current above 0.45 A under the release workload
measured converter efficiency below the 80% allocation in the release operating region
hardware_capacity_note: The 0.75 A main-rail design capacity and 4.815 W historical thermal vector remain transient/electrical stress sensitivities. They are not release steady-state operating allocations.
